x-m-el-res-05.s.s2.prompt: Wara nömörö naturel n 2 so ayeke ngbii ape so n²−n+41 ayeke nömörö premier ape.

x-m-el-res-06.title: Solution Atï Racine Tongana A Divisé
x-m-el-res-06.goal: Wara étape na yâ tî solution tî équation so racine atï, tene ndali ni, na sara solution nzoni.
x-m-el-res-06.material: Mbeni élève asara équation x² = x (x carré ayeke x) tongana so.
x-m-el-res-06.prereq.0: A lingbi tî sara équation tî degré use tongana x²=x (niveau tî collège)
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.prompt: Pika ligne ôko so asara solution ke ngangu ape. (Nömörö tî ligne atömba na 1.)
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bâ bê tî valeur wa expression ayeke lingbi ape tî ga tongana mo diviser ngbii use tî ni na ni.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.hint.1: Fa so ligne 3 afa gï so '1 ayeke solution' wala nga so 'gï 1 ayeke solution.'
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.1: Diviser ngbii use na x na mo wara x = 1.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.2: Tongana a zia x = 1, a wara 1 = 1, ni la ni ayeke nzoni.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.line.3: Ni la gï solution ayeke x = 1.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s1.explain: Na ligne 2, tî diviser ngbii use na expression ôko, expression so a lingbi tî ke 0 ape. Ndali so a sara division ni, a vérifier ni ape, conclusion 'gï ôko' na ligne 4 alingbi tî ke nzoni ape nga. Ligne 3 ayeke nzoni, me ni afa ape so solution tî ndö ayeke ape.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.prompt: Tene ndali so solution so ayeke problème, na sû solution nzoni kue.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.hint.0: Zia valeurs tî x tî wara so ayeke sara division na ligne 2 ayeke lingbi ape.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sara essai tî zia kue na x²−x=0 na sara solution ape na division.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Explication tî mo atene 'condition so a hunda tongana a diviser'?
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mo vérifier na mo zia solution tî solution tî mo so mo kiri sara na équation tî kozo?
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.model.0: Tongana x ayeke 0, ni ayeke tongana diviser na 0, so a ye ape. Ndali so x²−x=0, x(x−1)=0, x=0 wala x=1.
x-m-el-res-06.s.s2.model.1: Kozo tî diviser, a lingbi tî bâ cas x=0 na ndö tî ni. x=0 alingbi na équation, ni la solution ayeke valeurs use 0 na 1.

Atënë ti ala ayeke 7, 8, 6, 7, 8, 7, 9, 6, 1, 7 points, na moyenne ayeke 6,6 points. Zo ti kamarade so amû 1 point alingbi lo ke sara ni ti nzene, me ti hinga ni biani ayeke pëpe.
